cb12_m.label: L1, hindsight start time

m2.fill: first transaction in [t, startTime) with YES-terms price >= ask + 1c; size min(100, tx size)
m2.floor: net >= 0.5c per filled share and route net > 0
m2.robustness: quote +1.0c; trade-through 2c; top-5; start_edit; worst-case unclean; worst-case reach

cb12_m.outcomes: guarded SCREEN and HOLDOUT files (separate); unclean members 0.5 (worst case 1)
cb12_m.stage1: p < 0.01, floors, binding placebo, robustness, early Holm at alpha / 10 = 0.005 (full step-down at the batch end can add advances)

cb12_x.LABEL_X: L1, worn set, new moderator, hindsight end date

cb12_x.estimator: pooled AR(1) of the pair-demeaned gap on consecutive usable steps by horizon bin of the first step; HL = 10 min ln2 / (-ln rho); rho >= 1 -> inf (reported) and the 7 d cap in the contrast and bootstrap
cb12_x.guards: cross_venue_live refused; steps at or after T12_X_end refused; input mtime >= 2026-10-13 refused
cb12_x.label: L1, worn set, new moderator, hindsight end date
